text:
sam_procurement: Heads up — carrier says 10 A800 replacements are held in FRA customs. AWB LZ12345 flagged for 'insufficient invoice value'. Carrier says ETA 48-72h if we agree to inspection fee + brokerage. We need capacity for next week's Dedicated batch, any objections to expediting?

ali_logistics: Noted. Carrier is asking for HS code confirmation. We originally filed 8473. Customs asking for supporting commercial invoice + insurance valuation.

jess_enginfra: If we can get a partial release (>=6 units) into EU pool we can hot-swap into staging and avoid missing the commit. Can ops accept a temporary 6-unit deficit?

maria_ops: Expedited release + inspection fee ~€7k total. Suggest split cost with VendorX per contract clause 12b. @sam_procurement can you push on vendor contribution? :thinking_face:  

carrierbot: Carrier update: hold reason = 'declared value mismatch'. Required docs: commercial invoice, insurance reference, packing list. Example fields:
```
AWB: LZ12345
Invoice: INV-8812
Declared value per unit: EUR 195000
Insurance ref: TBD
```

sam_procurement: I uploaded a revised invoice but VendorX is requesting we sign a waiver for customs hold liabilities > €1M. That's outside our standard RMA terms. My proposal: negotiate partial release of 6 units with vendor covering inspection for those 6; Redwood covers the remainder for faster clearance on our side. Agree?

ali_logistics: Partial release is feasible but we must consolidate the remaining 4 under a single hold manifest (to avoid duplicate customs charges). Also require RMA tag applied to serials on the manifest to preserve warranty chain. Serial examples: 
```
SN: A8-2024-0001 .. A8-2024-0010
RMA prefix: RN-VE-2475
```

jess_enginfra: Good. Operational plan: if 6 arrive we can swap 6 into staging tonight (non-prod pool -> dedicated) and route 4 from US pool to cover any residual shortfall for production canary. Latency SLOs should be unaffected for ~48h.

VendorX_sales: We can contribute up to €5,000 toward brokerage/inspection for this incident if Redwood signs a limited liability waiver that caps vendor exposure for customs detention. Additionally, we will need a one-time handling surcharge for expedited release on the next PO (proposal: +2% on that PO).

maria_ops: +2% surcharge is a hard no from ops/legal unless vendor absorbs most of the fee. If VendorX covers €5k, Redwood can cover the remaining ~€2k but will not accept a unilateral waiver beyond standard RMA language.

sam_procurement: I'm pushing back. Accept vendor covering €5k, Redwood pays €2k. No price uplift. I'll send formal confirmation and ask them to sign a short addendum limited to this shipment.

ali_logistics: OK authorizing partial release of 6 units. I'll upload consolidated manifest to customs portal and tag the remaining hold reference HLD-789. Manifest link: https://shipments.example.com/manifests/LZ12345/manifest.pdf

carrierbot: Update: customs processed partial release — 6 units cleared to FRA depot for carrier handover. Remaining 4 units still on hold pending inspection (inspection slot booked tomorrow 09:00 CET).

sam_procurement: Thanks. Please capture all receipts and PO addendum so finance can process vendor credit for €5k. I'll draft the PO note for the €2k direct charge and send to VendorX for sign-off.

jess_enginfra: Swap window scheduled 02:00-05:00 UTC tonight. I'll coordinate with ops-runbook to avoid rollout collisions. @oncall-eng please monitor during the window in case of unexpected node evictions.

oncall-eng: Acknowledged. I'll watch SLO dashboards and standby. :white_check_mark:

maria_ops: Closing loop: once we have the signed addendum and credit note, approve the expedite payment. Also please add the serial-level RMA mapping to the incident ticket so we can reconcile warranty and billing later.
